configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Portable configure: use whatever C11 compiler the environment provides. Works on Linux and macOS alike.

configurePresets.name: macos-homebrew-llvm
configurePresets.description: Pin Homebrew's clang so build/compile_commands.json matches the Homebrew clang-tidy that `make tidy` runs (avoids the macOS dual-toolchain mismatch). macOS only: the Makefile selects this preset via uname on Darwin; on other Unix systems use the `default` preset.
